problemSigns.sign: Door won't lift or feels extremely heavy
problemSigns.detail: A broken spring removes the counterweight, making the door immovable or very difficult to lift.

problemSigns.sign: Visible gap in the torsion spring above the door
problemSigns.detail: A clear separation in the coiled spring confirms it is broken.

problemSigns.sign: Door lifts a few inches then stops
problemSigns.detail: This can happen when one of two extension springs breaks, causing uneven lifting.
Loose cables often mean the spring system is no longer tensioned correctly.
